title: Cancel unused SaaS licences at renewal
effort_why: licence review with 16 vendors, reduce seats at each renewal or notice date
assumptions: August 2026: 713 licences bought, 475 active in 30 days across 15 contract(s); keep active + 10%, cancel 186. Full effect once every contract has renewed (latest 2027-09-30).
risks: Annual contracts can only shrink at renewal; notice periods 30-90 days must be met.

title: Switch the production platform off at nights and weekends, outside protection windows
effort_why: scheduler with automatic start, test against finance close and nightly jobs, monitoring
assumptions: Off weekends 08:00-02:00 and working days 20:00-02:00; never on closing days or January working days: 3,210 of 8,760 h per year. Node-hours fall in proportion. Checked against every scheduled job run: 1,487 runs, 0 overlap an off window. Interactive use on working days is about 6.1 h (at most 9.1 h), so it fits before 20:00.
risks: Business hours come from daily data (active hours minus job hours), not hourly measurements; keep a 2 h buffer after office hours. Automatic start before 02:00 and before office hours.
conditions: R01 last 3 working days of each month, 18:00-04:00; R18 every day, 02:00-08:00; R19 every working day in January, 20:00-02:00

title: Run the development cluster only on working days 08:00-18:00 and during quarterly training
effort_why: auto-stop/auto-start policy for the cluster, keep quarterly training
assumptions: Running 2,728 of 8,760 h: working days 08:00-18:00 plus 24 h on training days. The cluster is idle 91 % today and its jobs may run between 08:00 and 18:00.
risks: Training must start automatically on days 1-3 of each quarter (rule R02).
conditions: R02 days 1-3 of January, April, July and October

title: Scale the test environments back from 64 to 16 vCPU
effort_why: resize test environments 64 -> 16 vCPU after go-live, regression test
assumptions: Enlarged from 16 to 64 vCPU for the customer portal project with scale-back planned after go-live (T-1058). CPU load of the test servers is 2-7 %.
risks: Confirm the go-live has happened; keep the acceptance-test freeze rule (R09) in mind for new releases.

title: Start the GPU server only when needed: working days 08:00-18:00 and quarterly training
effort_why: start/stop on demand with a schedule, keep quarterly training
assumptions: Running 2,728 of 8,760 h. Average GPU load is 6 % outside the four training weeks (about 43 % in them).
risks: Training days 1-3 of each quarter stay protected (rule R04).
conditions: R04 days 1-3 of January, April, July and October

title: Cancel unused Microsoft Copilot seats

title: Route simple tasks of ai-assistant to small models
effort_why: route simple tasks to small models in the AI gateway, quality check on samples
assumptions: Tasks Summarise, Translate on large models (CHF 8,294 in the baseline year) move to the provider's small model; price ratio small/large from the gateway: Azure OpenAI 0.29, OpenAI 0.18. No CO2 saving is claimed: the energy model has one factor per token, whatever the model size.
risks: Quality must be checked on samples per task before switching.
